description:
Search Buffet's upcoming curated picks by time window, neighborhood, price, category or free text.

Use this for specific asks: "free things to do in LA tonight", "live music this weekend in Silver Lake", "cheap happy hours on Friday", "something outdoors on Saturday". For the whole week's list with no filters, buffet_get_weekly_lineup is simpler.

Filters combine with AND. Text search matches title, venue, neighborhood, tags and description. Returns one page in date order; when more matches exist the result gives next_offset.

category.description: event (concerts, festivals, screenings), activity (festivals, markets, things to do), restaurant (a hangout at a bar or restaurant)

neighborhood.description: Neighborhood or area, e.g. "Silver Lake", "Downtown", "Santa Monica", "Westwood"

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

when.description: Relative window in Pacific time: today, tonight, tomorrow, this_weekend (Fri-Sun), this_week, next_week, or upcoming (everything listed)

name: buffet_search_events
title: Search Buffet events
